recipes.name: Owl Tears
recipes.ingredients: Deadly-nightshade juice and mandrake powder, distilled together.
recipes.crafting_process: Crush mandrake to powder, combine it with nightshade juice in a retort, and distill the mixture. The useful fraction is the resulting eye-irritating liquid.
recipes.description: Cloudy liquid with an exciting scent. Applied as eye drops, it gives the eyes a glossy appearance and dilates the pupils.
recipes.effect: Darkness level is reduced by 1 per 4 TP*. The increased light sensitivity follows the rules of CAT'S EYES: blinding lasts TP*/2 CR and dancing lights last TP*/4 GT. The effective TP* falls by 2 each hour until the effect ends. The nightshade poison inflicts 1 DP.
recipes.important_note: Plain nightshade juice can be used without a Brewing Test and counts as 4 TP*, but gives no benefit in complete darkness while retaining the harmful effects.
recipes.market_price_quality_c: about 0.1D for confirmed Quality C, as published.
recipes.source: Wege der Alchimie (2012), p. 36; price and procurement: pp. 202-203; material prices: pp. 208-209.

recipes.name: Invisible Ink
recipes.ingredients: Formula-dependent. Common versions use onion juice, apple juice, Peraine-apple juice, or milk. Other possible bases include filtered wood ash, saliva, or sweat. More complex versions require a separate catalyst liquid.
recipes.crafting_process: Prepare a colorless writing fluid from one of the published organic bases. The simplest forms are revealed by heat; more advanced variants are developed with a separate catalyst liquid and may fade again after cooling.
recipes.description: A colorless or self-vanishing writing fluid. The writing becomes visible through heat or a matching chemical catalyst. Color, odor, and exact behavior vary by formula.
recipes.effect: Writing made with the ink cannot be read without the appropriate revealing method.
recipes.market_price_quality_c: about 0.3D-1D for confirmed Quality C, as published.
recipes.source: Wege der Alchimie (2012), p. 36; price and procurement: pp. 202-203; material prices: pp. 208-209.

recipes.name: Cold Light / Phosphoros
recipes.ingredients: Several measures of stale, preferably rotten urine; alternatively phosphor mushrooms, bone ash, or egg yolk. The material is distilled, calcined without air, and stored under water.
recipes.crafting_process: Distill several measures of stale or rotten urine, then calcine the residue in the complete absence of air. Keep the finished luminous mass submerged in water; phosphor fungi, bone ash, or egg yolk are more laborious alternatives.
recipes.description: White to pale-yellow waxy material with a distinctive odor.
recipes.effect: When removed from water, it glows white in darkness and becomes hand-warm. Its light is equivalent to a FLIM FLAM with 2-4 SP*. One ounce is consumed after about 3 hours.
recipes.hazard: It ignites spontaneously at roughly 30-50 degrees Celsius. Ingestion of about one scruple is a stage 15 poison, inflicting 1d6-1 DP per GT for 2d20+5 GT; symptoms include vomiting and respiratory arrest. Burning material causes painful, poorly healing burns.
recipes.market_price_quality_c: about 1D for confirmed Quality C, as published.
recipes.source: Wege der Alchimie (2012), p. 36; price and procurement: pp. 202-203; material prices: pp. 208-209.

recipes.name: Pyrophor
recipes.ingredients: Lead ground into very fine dust and mandrake powder in an airtight vessel. Clubmoss spores or Orcland puffball spores can replace the lead.
recipes.crafting_process: Grind lead to the finest possible dust, mix it with mandrake powder, and seal it in an airtight vessel. Lycopodium or Orcland puffball spores may replace the lead for a similar ignition effect.
recipes.description: Lead-colored dust.
recipes.effect: The dust ignites spontaneously when it falls through air. It can ignite tinder or dry hay, but not substantial pieces of wood.

recipes.name: Shadow Chalk
recipes.ingredients: Alabaster dust, lime, and gall-apple juice, mixed and hardened.
recipes.crafting_process: Mix alabaster dust with lime and gall-apple juice, shape the resulting paste into sticks, and allow it to harden completely before use.
recipes.description: Pale-gray chalk, somewhat harder than ordinary chalk.
recipes.effect: Marks fade rapidly until invisible to ordinary human, elven, or orcish sight. They remain readable through a colored filter, such as thinly polished amber lenses.

recipes.name: Smoke Pouch
recipes.ingredients: Ash from charred fir cones, mandrake powder, sulfurous water, and prepared animal intestine used as the pouch.
recipes.crafting_process: Char fir cones, grind the ash, and mix it with mandrake powder. Dissolve the mixture in sulfurous water, dry it to a damp mass, pack it into prepared animal intestines, and dry the pouches again.
recipes.description: Gray to black granular material sealed in a dried intestine.
recipes.effect: Air contact creates dense gray smoke in a radius of about 3 paces. Treat the cloud as darkness imposing -5 AT and -5 PA. Visibility is limited to the shortest distances.
recipes.important_note: A careful user can slit the pouch to direct the smoke. This requires a DE Test; failure bursts the pouch at the wrong point and blinds the user's own position. Some tribal formulas add intoxicants.

recipes.name: Stink Pot
recipes.ingredients: Mandrake powder dissolved in stale water, plus a powerful foul-smelling substance such as skunk secretion, ground buckthorn bark, or dragon dung. The liquid is sealed in a thin clay pot with wax.
recipes.crafting_process: Dissolve mandrake powder in stale water and stir in a powerful stinking substance. Decant the sediment and liquid into thin clay pots and immediately dip them in wax to make the vessels airtight.
recipes.description: Vile-smelling liquid with a disgusting consistency.
recipes.effect: Breaking the vessel releases a nauseating stench in a 3-pace radius. Affected creatures must pass a Willpower Test penalized by TP*/2 and by Sensitive Sense of Smell, or vomit. Failure by 7 or more causes unconsciousness. Range and duration can vary with the odor source, from a few CR to several hours.

recipes.name: Tear Powder
recipes.ingredients: Crushed root of the Frisund rose, also called sneeze-root, mixed with chopped and dried hot-pepper or peppercorn seed and ground to powder.
recipes.crafting_process: Crush Frisund-rose root together with a chopped, dried pepper or paprika seed and grind the mixture to an extremely fine powder.
recipes.description: Brown powder with lighter and darker particles.
recipes.effect: A small squeeze pouch, hollow reed, or blowpipe can project one dose. A struck target suffers violent sneezing and tearing. Suppressing the sneezing requires Willpower +3. Tests requiring sight, concentration, or speech are penalized while the effect persists, as described by the source's exposure rules.

recipes.name: Wound Powder
recipes.ingredients: Mandrake powder; crushed healing herbs, especially bleeding-stoppers such as cliff-tooth, Tarnele, four-leaf oneberry, and Wirsel herb; plus a binder such as hematite dust, ground acorns, or onion seed.
recipes.crafting_process: Grind mandrake and blood-staunching herbs, then blend them with a dry binder such as hematite dust, ground acorns, or onion seed until a free-flowing wound powder forms.
recipes.description: Powder whose color and texture depend on the ingredients.
recipes.effect: Applied to an injury of up to 3 DP, it stops bleeding within moments and heals the injury during one night. On larger injuries it at least reduces blood loss. Multiple doses do not stack.

recipes.crafting_process: Roast the afterbirth dry, ignite it, and mix the residue with horse sweat and crushed Gulmond. Pressure-cook until blue and fully dissolved, distill forty-nine drops after cooling, mix them with Yagan oil, and add enough ground stone-oak acorn to roll three large lozenges.
recipes.description: Dark-blue lozenges with a bitter taste and pungent odor.

quality_tiers.text: Only a sense of well-being. Normal EP regeneration and Fatigue reduction occur, with reduced interference from disturbing conditions.

recipes.name: Prophylactic Antidote, Kukris Example
recipes.german_name: Prophylaktika, vorbeugende Gegengifte, am Beispiel Kukris
recipes.category_label: Spagyrik; each version is specialized against one poison
recipes.ingredients: 12 golden-chain fruits; 3 ounces Menchal juice; 1 rotten node from a Mirham silk-vine tendril; 1/2 ounce mercury; 1 liquid measure Mohaska; decoction from one clump Olgin root.
recipes.crafting_process: Burn the golden-chain fruits to ash while avoiding their poisonous fumes and mix the ash with Menchal juice. Pound the rotten silk-vine node with mercury, dilute with Mohaska, reduce and distill it, then combine the two preparations, heat for three days, add Olgin decoction, and distill seven flux.
recipes.description: Clear yellow liquid with a faint rotten odor. It must be taken before exposure.

quality_m.note: The user suffers half the damage of the target poison, or quality B for a tiered alchemical poison, in addition to any actual poisoning.

quality_tiers.text: A poison consumed within 6 hours has greatly weakened symptoms. Its damage begins after twice the normal delay but is not reduced.

Resistance is eased by 22. If no exposure occurs, the prophylactic inflicts the poison's full damage, or quality D for a tiered poison.

recipes.name: Powder of the Clear Mind / Anti-narcotic

recipes.ingredients: 5 Gulmond leaves; 1 Wirsel herb; 1 additional mandrake; 1 carat amethyst; 12 dried rose petals in white, red, pink, and yellow; 5 liquid measures sugar water; RESTORE ATTRIBUTES.
recipes.crafting_process: Boil Gulmond, Wirsel, and the four colors of rose petals in sugar water for one hundred heartbeats. Press the last liquid over a peeled mandrake, cast RESTORE ATTRIBUTES, grate the root into the kettle while watching the color change, and add amethyst at the prescribed point before drying and grinding the sweet-smelling powder.
recipes.description: Granular powder with a sweet aroma; it dissolves in water.

recipes.name: Restorarium

recipes.name: Sleeping Draught

Heat the raven feathers buried in Khom sand until black bubbles form, pound the hot mixture, combine it with the herbs, quench it with the berry-and-nut water, and leave the brew in moonlight until dawn.

recipes.name: Water of Peace
recipes.ingredients: 8 needles from a life tree; the seeds of 1 tiger-poppy capsule; 10 ounces alcohol; 2 ounces dried Ilmen leaf; 4 vervain leaves; 1/2 liquid measure of raindrops that have fallen through a rainbow.
recipes.crafting_process: During Travia, steep life-tree needles and tiger-poppy seed in alcohol for one night under Horas, then remove them. Distill the alcohol with Ilmen leaf and pressed vervain, keep the first sixteen clear drops, and mix them with rain that has fallen through a rainbow.

recipes.crafting_process: Grind the Myridanium crystal and owl pellet and break the Ilmen-leaf resin into small pieces. The next Prophecy Test is eased by 3.

recipes.name: Love Potion

recipes.name: Mengbilla Banbal Oil

recipes.crafting_process: Pressure-cook urine, one ounce of olive oil, Guraan blossoms, and dragonflies for one hour, cool and strain. Repeat with Ilmen leaf and a living Ikanaria butterfly, stir in vanilla and Samthauch without inhaling the pollen, discard the first two ounces of distillate, keep the next two, and pressure-cook them with two ounces of olive oil.
recipes.description: An influence oil normally applied to the body. If Velvet Breath is used, a failed batch also inflicts that substance's full damage.

quality_m.note: , plus the full damage of Velvet Breath.

recipes.name: Rainbow Dust

recipes.description: Shimmering powder that produces sleep, visions, dependency, and at its highest quality potentially permanent mental or spiritual consequences.

More vivid dreams; 2d6 DP within 5 hours; Willpower Test +7.
Visions for 7 hours and no damage; afterwards every attribute is reduced by 3 for 1 day.
Intense visions for 2d6 hours, without the lower-quality side effects.

recipes.name: Rethonicum
recipes.ingredients: 1 ounce splinters from an oak coffin; 1 scruple Aranian Crimson Lotus pollen; seeds from 1 black-poppy capsule; 1 liquid measure urine from a hibernating marmot; 1 measure double distillate; 1 additional mandrake; REST BODY.
recipes.crafting_process: Cast REST BODY on the mandrake and lull it to sleep in marmot urine for seven days, singing again at every dusk if needed. Mix the resulting green liquid with double distillate in a water bath, dust oak coffin wood with crimson-lotus pollen and black-poppy seed, burn it without air in the bath, and skim the ivy-colored, honey-thick substance.
recipes.description: Dark-green syrup that slows the body into increasingly deep deathlike stasis. It is not treated as a poison for CLARUM PURUM and can be ended with an Antidote of equal quality.

quality_tiers.text: For 1 hour breathing and heartbeat slow. All attribute Tests are penalized by 2, all Talent Tests by 6, and air consumption is halved.

For 3d6 hours the subject restores 2d6 VP, and poison and disease effects are suspended. Their durations resume afterwards.

recipes.name: Invisibility Elixir

recipes.name: Borbarad's Breath / Malmar's Soot / Naclador's Breath
recipes.ingredients: 3 carats onyx dust; 5 scruples carnelian splinters; 2 ounces Smoking Brown Oil; 1 finger-joint-sized shard of red obsidian; 2 ounces blood-elm resin; 2 stone pitch; 1 ounce Orazal adhesive; 1 liquid measure Breath of Nun'kun'tur; MELT SOLID.
recipes.crafting_process: On the first prescribed conjunction, dissolve onyx and carnelian in Smoking Brown Oil, inscribe and powder the red obsidian, melt blood-elm resin around it, and distill thirty-five drops. On the second conjunction, distill pale oil from pitch, combine both distillates, liquefy the resin with MELT SOLID, stir in Orazal, add the Breath of Nun'kun'tur, and seal the final vessel before air triggers it.
recipes.description: Warm, odorless black-red oil. On contact with air it spreads; at higher quality it forms a heavy dark-red gas that descends from above. Fire, sulfur, magic, or a demonic presence causes it to coagulate into adhesive soot that seals its target hermetically and extinguishes ordinary fire.

quality_tiers.text: On exposure to air the substance forms slippery pools. Quality B-F: The gas and sealing effect operate with increasing strength. For affected demons and otherworldly beings, the separation lasts 1d6 CR at B, 2d6 at C, 3d6 at D, 4d6 at E, and 5d6 at F; the being suffers 1d6 DP per CR. A manifest demon is normally banished by this separation. For living beings, respiratory openings are sealed for the same quality-scaled duration, causing the normal consequences of suffocation. Coverage: One stone protects approximately 20 cubic paces at B, 40 at C, 60 at D, 80 at E, or 100 at F.
